proof:
classical
letI : Module.Finite ℂ V := h_H003.1
let μ : Ix l → ℂ := fun i => ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)
have hμ : Function.Injective μ := by
  intro i j hij
  change ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) = ((l - 2 * (j.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) at hij
  have hz : l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) = l - 2 * (j.val : ℤ) := Int.cast_injective hij
  apply Fin.ext
  omega
have hlin : LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i : Ix l => ev y v i.val) := by
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
  intro c hc j
  let q : Polynomial ℂ :=
    ∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Ix l)).erase j, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (μ k))
  have hact (i : Ix l) :
      (Polynomial.aeval h q) (ev y v i.val) = q.eval (μ i) • ev y v i.val := by
    exact Module.End.aeval_apply_of_mem_apply_eq_smul (f := h) (p := q) (h_T002 i).2
  have hkill (i : Ix l) (hij : i ≠ j) : q.eval (μ i) = 0 := by
    simp only [q, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      ⟨i, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, sub_self _⟩
  have hnonzero : q.eval (μ j) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [q, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    intro heq
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1 (hμ heq).symm
  have happ := congrArg (fun z : V => (Polynomial.aeval h q) z) hc
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, hact, map_zero] at happ
  have hterm : (c j * q.eval (μ j)) • ev y v j.val = 0 := by
    calc
      (c j * q.eval (μ j)) • ev y v j.val =
          ∑ i : Ix l, c i • (q.eval (μ i) • ev y v i.val) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
        · exact mul_smul _ _ _
        · intro i hi hij
          rw [hkill i hij, zero_smul, smul_zero]
        · intro hj
          exact False.elim (hj (Finset.mem_univ j))
      _ = 0 := happ
  have hmul : c j * q.eval (μ j) = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hterm).resolve_right (h_T002 j).1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right hnonzero
have hcard : Fintype.card (Ix l) = Module.finrank ℂ V := by
  rw [h_H003.2.1]
  exact h_T001.2.2.2.1.2
refine ⟨basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' (fun i : Ix l => ev y v i.val) hlin hcard, ?_⟩
intro i
exact congrFun (coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank' (K := ℂ)
  (fun i : Ix l => ev y v i.val) hlin hcard) i
